scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on her account and requests a refund if unauthorized.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Tanisha Jefferson and I'm 34. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Tanisha, I'm sorry to hear you're seeing an unexpected charge. I would be happy to investigate this for you. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the email address associated with your profile for security verification?
Sure, my account number is 8829-4401-2290 and my email is t.jefferson@email.com.
Thank you. For final verification, please confirm the billing zip code on file and the last four digits of the phone number linked to your account.
The zip code is 90210 and the phone number ends in 5582.

Thank you, Tanisha. I have successfully verified your account. I see the $76 transaction from 'Global Tech Solutions' on October 12th. Since this merchant is not in your usual purchase history, I have checked our internal fraud database. It appears this merchant has a high rate of unauthorized subscription billing reports.
Oh, that sounds like a scam. I definitely didn't sign up for anything like that. Can you stop it from happening again?

I understand. Per our 'Unauthorized Transaction Policy', I have blocked all future charges from 'Global Tech Solutions' on your account. Additionally, I have processed a full refund of $76 to your original payment method. You should see the credit reflected in your balance within 3-5 business days.

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity, identified the merchant as a known source of unauthorized charges, blocked future billing, and issued a full refund.
